pairs.evidence: features/volby/ListPage.tsx:109 When a list is opened with a ?kraj= pin (KrajPage/ObecPage link every list with pinKraj), pinnedMembers can be empty for a list with no MPs from that kraj, and MembersTable renders its header over zero rows with no empty claim, under a lead that says 'these MPs of the list were elected there'. Empty is never named, which breaks the settled-empty rule.

techniques.evidence: features/volby/ListPage.tsx:43 MembersTable has no zero-row branch. The other volby tables do name their empty state (ContestedMatrix.tsx:32, ListsLedger.tsx:29), but the pinned-kraj subset can render as a header with an empty body.

features/volby/volbyLoader.ts:378 Lists sort by seats desc with a cs-collated label tiebreak. Members sort by name with a pspId tiebreak (volbyLoader.ts:167), which survives the stable re-sort at getListData.ts:74.
features/volby/getListData.ts:74 Ordering and pin predicate both run on the server (loader + RSC page), so no axis is split across tiers. Sets are small (lists, ≤ chamber members) and held whole.
features/volby/components/ListsLedger.tsx:61 Rows are keyed by system identity (slug, pspId, votePspId), not by index. The tables are small and server-rendered, so no windowing is needed.
features/volby/components/ListsLedger.tsx:35 A native table with read-only cells and one link per row header, plus sr-only caption and scope col/row. This is the right choice over a grid role.
features/volby/ListPage.tsx:79 There is no filter bar. The only predicate is a URL pin, applied server-side with the same rule as the loader.
features/volby/volbyLoader.ts:167 Every set is bounded by the 200-seat chamber, so the full set renders with no window.
